title: Systematic identification of Y-chromosome gene functions in mouse spermatogenesis | Science
content: The mammalian Y chromosome is essential for male fertility, but which Y genes regulate spermatogenesis is unresolved. We addressed this by generating 13 Y-deletant mouse models. In Eif2s3y, Uty, and Zfy2 deletants, spermatogenesis was impaired. We found ...
